lines.2: At last, I had cooled down.
lines.3: Still, I could hardly believe she had said yes.
lines.4: Every time I remembered, the happiness came rushing back.
lines.5: A date with the Princess. Just the two of us.
lines.7: Back there, I had answered on pure momentum, exactly like the old me.
lines.8: Give it time, though, and the pressure really started weighing on me.
lines.9: Not that I was looking forward to it any less.
lines.13: 「Yeah. I am a trustworthy gentleman, aren't I?」
lines.14: 「I never said anything remotely like that.」
lines.16: I forced it into Yashi's hand.
